approved_scope.title: State the PQ level of every assigned protocol in one table
approved_scope.description: State the PQ level of every assigned protocol in one table
acceptance_criteria: PROTOCOL.md section 5.4.2 is the only PQ-level table. Everyday 0x01 is X25519 only. Extra lock 0x02 still needs the PSK after a break of X25519. Hybrid 0x04 and 0x05 need both X25519 and ML-KEM-768. 0x03 stays unassigned. A future group wrap must meet the Extra lock level or the hybrid level. SECURITY.md, the README, PARITY.md, and the six language READMEs point at that section.
